name: cloudflare-doctor-evals
description: Repo-level eval manifest for Cloudflare Doctor. Deterministic runners cover skill triggering and scanner detection; the shared benchmark covers model-graded audit quality.
assertions: positive Cloudflare audit prompts trigger the skill
false friends and unrelated generic prompts do not trigger the skill
expected product/intent terms are present in the skill description
every detection fixture's required check IDs are emitted by the scanner
the clean-baseline fixture produces zero findings
the check coverage matrix stays consistent with the scanner registry
